interface.longDescription: Search primary legal materials, retrieve source metadata and excerpts, analyze aggregate patterns, and trace relationships among laws, decisions, citations, and legislative history. Ten provider-neutral legal workflows are included; more are available from the public Legalcode plugin repository.

Trace which Icelandic law implements the GDPR.
Show me how Legalcode can research a legal issue and verify the resulting authorities.
